name: This operation always evaluates to false
description: A binary operation always evaluates to `false` regardless of its operands' runtime values.
fullDescription: This binary operation always evaluates to `false` regardless of the runtime value of its operands, based on the semantics of the operator and a constant operand (e.g. comparisons against `int:MAX_VALUE`/`int:MIN_VALUE`/`float:Infinity`). This is usually unintended and indicates dead logic or a mistake in the condition.
